compute_bound_exclusions.reason: Structural simulator speed limitation: 4-7h per problem size vs the 7200s per-simulation invocation contract. These benchmarks are excluded from tier-1 CI pass/fail criteria. See docs/runner_configuration.md for details.

l1_cache_bw.reason: Selected MI300A rows are all below the 2x-min flat threshold; the workload holds total reads fixed and sweeps cache footprint/residency rather than work amount.

l2_cache_bw.reason: Selected MI300A hardware rows are all below the 2x-min flat threshold; only 5 simulator rows completed, and they are in the same flat cache-footprint regime.

value_change_proof.reason: Loaded hardware rows must exceed the 2x-min flat threshold before boosted/trend scoring treats this work axis as value-changing.

l1_cache_bw.reason: New L1 cache-bandwidth rows scale total reads with num_elements. HIP/CUDA rows hold working_set_size fixed; the Go simulator sample keeps each 256-thread read group L1-resident while total input allocation grows with num_elements. Score/trend only when loaded rows prove non-flat value-changing behavior.

value_change_proof.reason: Loaded hardware rows must exceed the 2x-min flat threshold before boosted/trend scoring treats this work axis as value-changing.

l2_cache_bw.reason: New L2 cache-bandwidth rows scale total reads with num_elements while holding the L2-resident working set fixed; score/trend only when loaded rows prove non-flat value-changing behavior.
